run.rule: All requested records must be present; no failure/example filtering. Gold joined after parsing.
run.cache_coordinate_conversion: Source pixel coordinates mapped to PDF points at 200 DPI before parsing, matching the production neutral PDF wrapper. No OCR value edits.
run.parser_development: 24 source training images; validation model choice is separate; calibration is not parser fitting.

threshold_policy: Diagnostic only. Existing minimum-60 gate remains a quality heuristic; confidence is not a correctness probability or invoice automation.
selection: PP-OCRv5 English mobile chosen for validation extraction quality, local CPU compatibility and ~3.1M stored model values; GPU VLM qualification reported separately.
limitations: Validation is development evidence, not production accuracy
No new training/fine-tuning; parser developed on 24 training images
Source labels not independently audited; no linked PO/approval truth
No ambiguous date guessing to improve recall
Timing includes shared-host contention and first model load
